Warp Finance was exploited on December 17,18, 2020, when an attacker manipulated the price oracle for Uniswap LP token collateral using flash loans. The attacker borrowed and withdrew roughly $7.7 million in stablecoins. The team later recovered a portion of the collateral, enabling reimbursement of about $5.85 million to users. The protocol's price oracle for Uniswap LP token collateral relied solely on pool reserves, allowing an attacker to manipulate the LP price with flash-loans. The system did not use manipulation-resistant or time-weighted price references.
